d: In this video, Firstpost explains the growing global backlash against AI data centres as protesters breach a Microsoft construction site in Amsterdam. From demonstrations across Europe to rising environmental concerns, the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is facing increasing scrutiny. Why are activists opposing these projects? And how could rising electricity demand, water consumption and environmental concerns affect Britain's AI ambitions and economic growth?
